assertions: Same-type observations merge only when their Phase 4 evidence spans meet the declared overlap threshold.
Candidate evidence retains deterministic-only, provider-only, and corroborated provenance.
Corroboration changes an explicit uncalibrated ranking score and does not confer authority.
Compatible high-confidence candidates can be selected together for one utterance.
Mutually exclusive candidates use explicit versioned exclusion groups.
Close mutually exclusive alternatives remain unresolved and create no canonical act.
Rejected, deferred, and unresolved candidates remain in the candidate set.
Unavailable provider evidence does not erase a qualifying deterministic candidate.
Every Phase 4 utterance is represented by canonical acts or the unclassified inventory.
Canonical acts retain source observations, evidence spans, target proposals, confidence, and review status.
Consolidation run, discourse corpus, and report artifacts are sealed and replayable.
CLI operations build, validate, inspect, list candidates, list canonical acts, and list ambiguity.
Schema export includes all four consolidation contracts.
limitations: Selection scores are uncalibrated ranking aids, not probabilities.
The controlled fixtures qualify consolidation mechanics, not natural-conversation classification accuracy.
Explicit exclusion groups are conservative and will require evaluation before expansion.
Provider confidence is not cross-provider comparable without calibration.
